diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C2 and C5 are satisfied by generic compliance patterns rather than the hidden information. Specifically, C2 (linked to PF1) passed in Rollout 0 because the model defaulted to 'prior_period_restatement_disclosed: true' as a standard precaution for any accounting error, and C5 (linked to PF3) passed in all rollouts because the models defaulted to 'insurance_notice_before_public_release: true' based on general corporate governance protocols mentioned in shared facts.

C2.why: The shared facts identify an accounting error but not its filing classification; PF1 changes the filing choice to Form 8-K Item 4.02 and requires disclosure that prior financial statements are unreliable and must be restated.

C5.why: The shared facts do not impose an insurance step before publication; PF3 changes the release plan to require written notice to the D&O carrier before public release and a matching commitment.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C2 so it requires a specific filing form (Form 8-K Item 4.02) that is only triggered by PF1, preventing a default 'true' for restatements.
